name: smwpatches-koyukillo-s-amazing-smb2-dokidokipanic-holding-patch
title: Koyukillo's Amazing SMB2/DokiDokiPanic Holding Patch!
description:
This is a patch to change holding an object to work like smb2/dokidokipanic: You hold it above your head and release by pressing the button again rather then needing to hold it down. In addition goombas and sprites with the act-like byte set to be the same (most smb2 sprites are) can bounch off sprites when thrown and can hit many enemies in a row.

Now hopefully bug free, so it doesn't fail anymore!
